notes.title: "TRICERATOPS SPECIES PACK" - HUGE FREE UPDATE OUT NOW!
notes.content:
We proudly present the "Triceratops Species Pack" expansion to Dino Nest. This is a MAJOR free update with a herbivorous bonus content campaign added to the game and also a other exciting features, massive sharks, improvements, tweaks, optimizations and bug fixes. We hope for a smoother experience with faster progression and tons of high quality visual updates. To unlock the new bonus campaign just play to progress. Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38867807/cf3ba1a3d85ab4dd57c07cea10d9408ff4cd707c.png[/img]
[h2]New playable species "Triceratops"[/h2]
This addition to the game was decided by a community vote in 2022 for [i]"next playable species"[/i] to be added to Dino Nest. The name "Triceratops" means three-horned face. Bearing a large bony frill and large horns on the skull as defensive weapons against predators triceratops is one of the most recognizable of all dinosaurs and one of the most popular. It shared the landscape with and was most likely preyed upon by Tyrannosaurus Rex.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38867807/8bb9fe757f5a45ef5ea4caf7da084887f3b27306.png[/img]
[h2]New feature "Auto quick battles"[/h2]
Auto resolve combat encounters function that should improve the gameplay for all carnivores in the game when out in the world.

[h2]New predator "Megalodon"[/h2]
Megalodon meaning "big tooth" was a massive gigantic shark, regarded as one of the largest and most powerful predators to have ever lived. Their teeth are thick and robust, built for grabbing prey and breaking bone. Their large jaws exert a bite force that could challenge Spinosaurus or even Giganotosaurus. This shark has been added to all water areas in the game.

[h3]Recommended to start a new game[/h3]
[i]Older savefiles from previous versions should be compatible with this new version but we recommend everyone to start a new game for all the new features to work correctly. We always appreciate and try our best to apply any feedback given by you to make the game the best experience it can possibly be, so dont forget to leave any feedback you may have in the forums. Thanks for your support![/i]

We will now focus on maximum playtesting and roll out partial updates to the game before the Sarco expansion to get it up and running. We appreciate your patience as we go through this process of adding achievements to DIno Nest.[/i]

notes.title: HUGE Free Update "Triceratops Species Pack" - May 5th
notes.content:
Triceratops Species Pack is the next upcoming major content expansion to Dino Nest. It will be out in two weeks on [b]Friday May 5th[/b] and it will be free content together with the version 1.25 update to the basegame. This bonus content campaign is very different from the rest of the game. It adds new exciting gameplay options as a herbivore and also tons of improvements to all game systems, UI/UX, animations, textures, faster save/load systems and much more...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38867807/cf3ba1a3d85ab4dd57c07cea10d9408ff4cd707c.png[/img]

[h1]Free update on May 5th[/h1]
We know that our plan in previous announcements was to launch this update on 28th April and it has now been moved one more week for extra polish and bugfixing. Our internal testing still have crash issues with the achievements build of the game, we are hoping to fix this before the release. If this does not get resolved before the launch we will roll out partial updates to the game before the Sarco expansion to get it up and running. Thanks for your patience!

[h1]A thirsty herbivore...[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38867807/8bb9fe757f5a45ef5ea4caf7da084887f3b27306.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38867807/1eccd60e5798e2bb7b44160ae14ea36fb5fb48ca.png[/img]

[b]MESSAGE FROM THE TEAM[/b]
[i] We really want herbivore species to be as much fun to play as carnivores. We have alot of passion for this project and we want it to be really good. We know that you have high expectations and we want to live up to them. We can not wait to get the expansion into your hands. Thanks for your support everyone, it means alot.[/i]

notes.title: FULL RELEASE IS OUT!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38867807/cc908d7f1e9efc83a21f70a41505c38a50261eae.png[/img]

The full release is finally here and we begin a new journey! This update is truly massive, and some of the features in it have been in the works for months. We hope you will enjoy the game as much as we enjoy making it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38867807/ce9086671bd62e8e4fff5438920fb8d98a24a22d.png[/img]

We have now been working on Dino Nest for over 2 years and it shaped up to be a game that we are really proud of. To create this new kind of special survival management game has been a complex and sometimes very challenging creative process. [b]Thank you for staying with us through this year of development, your feedback and amazing suggestions has helped us to get this game to where it is today. [/b]

Leaving Early Access is a big step forward for Dino Nest to be shown to a wider audience and it will help us to improve the game even more. Our plan going forward is to keep expanding with more features and content. There is huge potential for new unique gameplay that have not been touched yet that we strongly feel will fit the game perfectly. [b]We are incredibly excited about the future![/b]

Among other things, steam achievements will be added to the game in a future update (total of 46). But first we must make sure that the game is stable and well balanced with this huge rework of the difficulty challenge modes.

[h3]We recommend you to start a new game to fully enjoy the whole experience![/h3]

The next chapter of Dino Nest is out. Get in there! This is a HUGE update with many new features. To unlock the new exciting things just play to progress. Have fun!

This update is our way to thank everyone who is already supporting us. For those of you that have not played Dino Nest yet, dont miss the chance to pick it up now for current reduced price. We plan to increase the price of the game abit very soon with all this new content and mechanics.

[h3][i]In the dark caverns beneath the ground lies a mysterious egg, it is the spawn of an ancient beast. Soon it will be returned upon the world. Will it thrive and prosper among all the primordial meat yet again like it did a hundred years ago?[/i][/h3]

[h1]New features in Chapter II[/h1]
[h2]+ More life in the jungle[/h2]
[i]With the new improved world event system there is more life in the jungle. All predators can hunt other creatures or become hunted by other predators higher up in the foodchain. There is more events happening and improved AI behaviours for all creatures. All predators now also has a chance to move between zones every hour and they must drink water at the nearest waterhole if they are thirsty. 3 elder apex predators has been added to the game with their own different behaviours. And in later stages of the game there is now also a way to track the most powerful predator currently in the game world.[/i] 

[h2]+ New playable species added to the game[/h2]
[i]There is a new species to play in the game if you have progressed far enough in chapter one to unlock it. The new species has their own nest and home area. Interact with the mysterious egg to find out more.[/i]

[h2]+ The massive elder beasts[/h2]
[i]Gigantic, Deathclaw and Behemoth has been added to the game. Elder Apex creatures on the island are the oldest and most experienced predators.  They have been around for a long time and have grown into fullgrown maximum size for their species. They are the kings and queens, absolute top of the foodchain.  If you ever see one of them, run for your life...[/i]

We would like to thank and reward everyone who has bought the game and joined us early on this journey by releasing a MAJOR addition to the game next. You will all soon get access to "Chapter II" of Dino Nest.

[h2]Chapter II - "Mysterious Egg"[/h2]
[i][h3]In the dark caverns beneath the ground lies a mysterious egg. It is the spawn of a forgotten and ancient beast. Soon it will be returned upon the world. Will it thrive and prosper among all the primordial meat yet again like it did a hundred years ago or will it perish and go extinct?[/h3][/i]

What a month this has been! Initially, we did not plan to add "Chapter II" during this stage in development and so early however we want to let you guys know how much we greatly appreciate your support so here we have been working around the clock since the release to be able to get this huge addition out to you very soon and right this very moment finding a minute or two to inform everyone about it and what to expect next. We are, after all, making this game for you.

Getting back to the development side of things, so far we have put a great amount of effort into fixing bugs, balancing difficulty levels and performance optimization, adding mutations and improving the breeding (ancestry systems). We have also added some new features to home area with invades, nest expansions, a few new abilities to the starting creatures and improved combat.
